data.name: Abar
data.gender_notes: Abar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Arabic, Abar is derived from the root 'abara' which means 'to be heavy, abundant, or numerous'. The name signifies the father of a large and prosperous family. The name Abar carries the meaning “Father of the multitude” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Abar usually hope their child will grow to embody father of the multitude and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of leadership and responsibility, reflecting the weight of one's duty towards their family and community.
data.etymology: Abar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Father of the multitude.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: The name Abar is steeped in Arab cultural significance, implying ancestry from a line of powerful and successful leaders. It is a name that connotes strength, prosperity, and the function of a nurturing father figure. In the Arab world, family is an essential part of daily life and personal identity, and so a name that speaks to this valuable bond carries great weight.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Islamic tradition, the name Abar also holds spiritual significance as it can be interpreted to mean a generous giver from Allah, one who is constantly showering His blessings upon those around them. The name reflects the virtues of benevolence, magnanimity, and compassion, and is often associated with individuals possessing strong moral character and a dedication to providing for their loved ones. It invokes images of abundance and contentment, and serves as a reminder of the blessings that Allah bestows upon us every day.
